findings.verification: Three historical candidate packets contained pre-repair hashes; Mossback and Barkguard already matched.
findings.resolution: Added final-digest-freeze.json as the only authoritative post-review digest table, with explicit supersession pointers and a byte-level integration test.

findings.verification: Signal Ruin enumerated all three dimensions every 20 ticks despite global_scans_per_tick=0.
findings.resolution: Runtime interval now iterates a maximum-two active-anchor registry; the only dimension scan is one-time world-load recovery.

findings.verification: reward_issued was committed before the loot command, permitting permanent loss on command failure.
findings.resolution: A uniquely tagged persistent chest-minecart cache is now created/reconciled and deterministically filled before reward_issued and COMPLETE are committed.

findings.verification: The activation callback has no await/yield; Script API events execute serially and ACTIVE was synchronously written before another callback. No TOCTOU window was demonstrated.
findings.resolution: An immediate activeAnchors reservation plus rollback was added before other activation mutation.

findings.verification: The authoritative report explicitly calls Stable a boot/restart gate and Preview a diagnostic harness, lists undelivered production events, and keeps real gameplay/client/PS4 gates pending.
findings.resolution: Existing limitation language retained; no gameplay certification claim added.

findings.verification: Static tests cannot prove getBiome/isOp behavior on the pinned engine; BDS boot did load the scripted pack without a startup failure.
findings.resolution: Kept runtime exception guards and the desktop-client activation/reset/biome gate explicitly pending.

findings.verification: Forest Attunement iterated the entire player array although its planning cap is four.
findings.resolution: The 100-tick callback now slices the player list to four and the feature test asserts the cap.

findings.verification: Native ready-state removal is structurally contention-aware but simultaneous two-client atomicity is not proven.
findings.resolution: Limitation remains explicit; live two-client interaction stays pending and is not represented as passed.

findings.verification: Gloamwing damage/death events are not wired to native triggers and damage does not remove mutually exclusive attack groups.
findings.resolution: Candidate remains internal/static with desktop combat pending; wiring and exclusivity are required before gameplay promotion.

findings.verification: Barkguard correctly triggers after damage, but API failure between effect/cooldown and equipment write could create a partial activation.
findings.resolution: No mitigation-of-triggering-hit claim exists; injected failure and live damage evidence remain required before gameplay promotion.

findings.verification: Signal Ruin's generic CLEAN label overstated its allowlisted production-input inspection.
findings.resolution: Renamed to NO_CONTAMINATION_OBSERVED_WITHIN_DISCLOSED_PRODUCTION_INPUTS and recorded method and scope.

findings.verification: Feature suites contain static/model tests, while the authoritative batch report already separates them from runtime gameplay evidence.
findings.resolution: Static/model evidence remains useful but cannot promote pending gameplay gates.

findings.verification: The reserved completion marker was declared but not emitted.
findings.resolution: Reward commit now idempotently sets world dynamic property ccoriginal_cc:signal_ruin_completed.

findings.verification: Mixed minimum engine versions are legal but do not prove each older declared floor.
findings.resolution: The tested current Stable/Preview binaries remain the only server evidence; exact-minimum and Creator Tools gates remain pending.

findings.verification: No physical PS4, Marketplace, Realm, push, tag, or release claim was made.
The original-production lane, disjoint reservations, and write-scope isolation are sound process scaffolding.
findings.resolution: Retained ORIGINAL_BEDROCK_NATIVE language; no clean-room certification claim is introduced.
